name: Okta-observed GenAI facilitator workflow

attribution.legal_posture: Security-vendor research finding; legal identity and adjudication remain outside the finding.

caveats: Use of a named category of legitimate service requires corroboration before supporting DPRK activity.
Okta could generally observe service logins; activity beyond the login page remains outside observation, and several proposed use cases remain hypotheses based on service functionality.

statements: Okta observed suspected DPRK personas/facilitators signing into GenAI-enhanced services for unified multi-channel communications, voice/text translation, job advertising, ATS-oriented resume optimization, automated application completion and tracking, interview hosting/recording/coaching, and generic LLM assistance.
Okta assessed that fake front-company vacancies could be used to collect legitimate resumes and cover letters and learn which features pass employer ATS screening.
